rules: Frames are integer and zero-based at 24 fps; one second equals 24 frames. Intervals are half-open.
shift_action moves start and end by the same delta. Other actions remain fixed.
When delaying a reaction, decide whether its gesture should follow. Shift both explicitly if the brief asks for that relationship.
Validate all edits as one atomic transaction. If an overlap/end overflow appears, repair the schedule before applying.
Inspect before proposing a revision; expected_revision prevents stale edits. Undo creates a new revision.
inspection: Playable preview plus contact sheet/action-boundary frames; human or vision review for appeal.
stop: Stop when requested effect is reviewed or workflow budget is exhausted.
